`final class UIMouseScrollEvent<U extends UI>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`UIInputEvent<U>`](/reference/events/uiinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.ui` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIMouseScrollEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/ui/UIMouseScrollEvent.java)

The event of `handleMouseScroll` on a UI, with the position of the pointer and the turn of the wheel that no node consumed.

## Learn more

- [Events](/use/learn/interactivity/events/#follow-an-input-through-the-tree)

|---|---|---|

<a id="UIMouseScrollEvent-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `double` | [getMouseX](#UIMouseScrollEvent-method-getMouseX)() | Returns the horizontal position of the pointer, in design pixels of the UI. |
| `double` | [getMouseY](#UIMouseScrollEvent-method-getMouseY)() | Returns the vertical position of the pointer, in design pixels of the UI. |
| `double` | [getNotchesX](#UIMouseScrollEvent-method-getNotchesX)() | Returns the horizontal turn of the wheel or of the touchpad, in notches, fractions included. |
| `double` | [getNotchesY](#UIMouseScrollEvent-method-getNotchesY)() | Returns the vertical turn of the wheel, in notches, fractions included: positive when the wheel turns up, negative when it turns down. |
